fusions.name: Webbed Lunge
fusions.desc: A lunging strike that deals 4 damage, rising to 1.4 times that at its full reach of 4 tiles. Its damage rises 5% for every 100 paces you have covered since you last used it (max 30%).

fusions.name: Marching Thump
fusions.desc: Stamps out a beat that deals 28 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles. When it hits, you and your allies deal 20% more damage for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Roadside Breather
fusions.desc: Restores 3 stamina a second for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Pavement Waddle
fusions.desc: On paved ground, your dodge chance rises by 12%. Your other abilities' cooldowns are 6% shorter.
